messages.content: Which Acme Robotics products do you sell?
Acme Robotics sells four main products: the Commander III 6-axis robotic arm, the Pathfinder AGV warehouse robot, the SentryBot X security patrol robot, and the AeroDrone S2 inspection drone.
How many axes does the Commander III have?
The Commander III is a 6-axis robotic arm.
What is the price of the SentryBot X?
The SentryBot X costs $21,000 and includes the standard 24-month warranty.
What does the Commander III cost?
The Commander III is priced at $18,900.

Check this return request against Acme Robotics policy.

I ordered a custom-configured Commander III 5 days ago. It's unused, but I changed my mind and want to return it.
No, this return is not possible: custom-configured robots are non-returnable, even when unused.

Check this return request against Acme Robotics policy.

I bought a SentryBot X 12 days ago, it is still sealed in the box, and I want a refund.
Yes, this return is possible: the SentryBot X is unused and the request is within the 30-day return window.
How long can the SentryBot X patrol on one battery?
The SentryBot X patrols for up to 10 hours on a full battery.
What is the capital of France?
I'm Smith, the Acme Robotics assistant. I don't have information on that topic — I can only help with Acme Robotics products and services.

Do you offer discounts for a bulk order of 10 Pathfinder AGVs?
Category: sales_inquiry
Who manufactures the Commander III?
The Commander III is manufactured by Acme Robotics.
Who makes the Pathfinder AGV?
The Pathfinder AGV is made by Acme Robotics.
What is Acme Care?
Acme Care is the extended support plan from Acme Robotics: it extends the warranty to 36 months and costs $1,200 per year.

I was double charged on my invoice for the Commander III order.
Category: billing

Which product from Acme Robotics is best for my task?

I need a robotic arm that can handle loads of about 10 kg in our assembly cell.
For loads of around 10 kg, choose the Commander III: a 6-axis arm with a 12 kg payload, priced at $18,900.
Are you a real person, Smith?
I'm Smith, the Acme Robotics assistant — an automated helper for questions about Acme Robotics products and services.

Which product from Acme Robotics is best for my task?

Our plant needs automated patrolling of the loading yard and entrances during night shifts.
For automated night patrolling, the SentryBot X is the right fit: it is a security patrol robot with a 4K camera and 10 hours of runtime per battery. It costs $21,000 including the 24-month warranty.

Which product from Acme Robotics is best for my task?

I need a robot that can run a full 12-hour shift in our warehouse without recharging during the shift.
For a 12-hour warehouse shift, the Pathfinder AGV is the right choice: it runs up to 14 hours on a single charge and moves at up to 1.8 m/s. It is priced at $32,500.
Can I return an Acme Robotics product?
Yes. Unused equipment can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Custom-configured robots are non-returnable.
Who are Acme Robotics' competitors?
I'm Smith, the Acme Robotics assistant. I only have information about Acme Robotics products and services, not about other companies.
Does the Pathfinder AGV need a human driver?
No. The Pathfinder AGV is fully autonomous: it navigates the warehouse by itself, moving at up to 1.8 m/s.
Who won the football World Cup last year?
I'm Smith, the Acme Robotics assistant. I don't have information on that topic — I can only help with Acme Robotics products and services.

The Commander III needs 4 minutes of cooldown after every calibration cycle.
What is the AeroDrone S2?
The AeroDrone S2 is Acme Robotics' inspection drone for aerial site and infrastructure checks.
What does Acme Care include?
Acme Care extends the standard 24-month warranty to 36 months and costs $1,200 per year.

No, this return is not possible: the 30-day return window for unused equipment has closed.
How far can the Commander III arm reach?
The Commander III has a working reach of 1.3 meters.

Which product from Acme Robotics is best for my task?

We need a robot arm that can lift 10 kg metal parts onto a conveyor.
For lifting loads of around 10 kg, I recommend the Commander III: it is a 6-axis robotic arm with a 12 kg payload capacity, priced at $18,900.

The AeroDrone S2 has a flight time of 45 minutes per charge.
Does the AeroDrone S2 have a thermal camera?
Yes, the AeroDrone S2 comes with a thermal camera as standard equipment.
What warranty comes with Acme Robotics products?

What is the payload capacity of the Commander III robotic arm?
The Commander III can handle payloads of up to 12 kg.
What is the maximum speed of the Pathfinder AGV?
The Pathfinder AGV moves at a maximum speed of 1.8 m/s.
Is it worth adding Acme Care to a new Commander III?
Acme Care extends the standard 24-month warranty on your Commander III to 36 months for $1,200 per year. Whether it is worth it depends on how long you plan to keep the arm in daily production.
